findings.issue: Wrong verb in the literal mirror: 持ってる means 'has / is holding', not 'is reading'. The lit_pt correctly says 'está-tendo'; lit_en teaches a sense-changing wrong meaning.
findings.current: That child [は] manga [を] a lot is-reading [explanatory んだ].
findings.suggested: That child [は] manga [を] a lot is-having (has) [explanatory んだ].

findings.issue: Wrong reading: 3分間 is read さんぷんかん (sanpun-kan) — the counter 分 takes ぷ after さん — not さんふんかん.
findings.current: さんふんかんだけまってやる。
findings.suggested: さんぷんかんだけまってやる。

findings.issue: Follows the kana reading error: 3分間 is 'sanpunkan', not 'sanfunkan'.
Token reading wrong in context: after さん (3), 分間 is pronounced ぷんかん (さんぷんかん), not ふんかん.
Meaning inverted by a double negative: 'it rarely fails to happen' means it almost always happens. めったにない = 'rarely exists/happens', as the expl itself states ('rarely exists').
findings.current: As for her going out of town, it rarely fails to happen.
findings.suggested: As for her going out of town, (it) rarely exists (hardly ever happens).

findings.issue: 'raramente não existe' reads in Portuguese as 'quase sempre existe' — the opposite meaning. The expl_pt itself gives the correct literal 'a ocasião de... raramente existe'.
findings.current: Quanto à coisa de ela sair da cidade, raramente não existe.
findings.suggested: Quanto à coisa de ela sair da cidade, raramente existe.

findings.issue: Four spurious fragment tokens (土曜/どよう, 日/び, 日曜/にちよう, 日/び, all null glosses) are prepended before 先週, duplicating 土曜日/日曜日; the token sequence no longer concatenates to the sentence.
findings.current: 土曜(どよう)・日(び)・日曜(にちよう)・日(び) before 先週
findings.suggested: Delete tokens[0..3]; the token list should start at 先週.

findings.issue: Leaked internal editorial comment in a learner-facing note: "o gloss 'to print' é ruído" / "the gloss 'to print' is noise" references a gloss that is not even present; it is QA meta-text, not content.
findings.current: raiz de する; o gloss 'to print' é ruído / root of する; the gloss 'to print' is noise
findings.suggested: raiz de する (verbo leve de 自殺する) / stem of する (light verb of 自殺する)

findings.issue: Accent error: 'cortes' should be 'cortês' (uma maneira muito cortês).
findings.current: vira uma maneira muito cortes de perguntar a identidade de quem ligou
findings.suggested: vira uma maneira muito cortês de perguntar a identidade de quem ligou

findings.issue: Accent error: 'forma cortes' should be 'forma cortês'.
There is no suffix ～っぱい in Japanese; the intended contrast is with the homophone 一杯 (counter 杯, 'one cupful'). As written it invents a nonexistent morpheme.
findings.current: Note that いっぱい appears as 'a lot,' not as the suffix ～っぱい.
findings.suggested: Note that いっぱい here is the adverb 'a lot', not 一杯 ('one cupful', with the counter 杯).

findings.issue: Same as expl_en: 'o sufixo ～っぱい' does not exist; the real contrast is with o homófono 一杯 (contador 杯, 'um copo cheio').
findings.current: Note que いっぱい aparece como 'muito', e não como o sufixo ～っぱい.
findings.suggested: Note que いっぱい aqui é o advérbio 'muito', e não 一杯 ('um copo cheio', com o contador 杯).

findings.issue: Violates the corpus phonetic convention (は→わ, へ→え, を→お): the object particle を is left as を instead of お, while は is correctly written わ in the same line.
findings.current: そのこわまんがをいっぱいもってるんだ。
findings.suggested: そのこわまんがおいっぱいもってるんだ。

findings.issue: どれも refers to things ('any/every one of them'), but 'everyone' means people (だれも) — a distinction the course teaches; token gloss correctly has 'any one (of them)'.
findings.current: To me, everyone seems the same, but.
findings.suggested: To me, every one (of them) seems the same, but.
